findings.title: A caller transaction cannot be opened through an in-IRIS cursor
findings.intended: docs/USER_GUIDE.md 'Writes inside your transaction': after SQL START TRANSACTION the caller's ROLLBACK removes IVG's write; no exception for EmbeddedConnection.
findings.observed: EmbeddedCursor.execute returns before sending START TRANSACTION, BEGIN, BEGIN TRANSACTION, COMMIT, ROLLBACK (iris_vector_graph/embedded.py:312-321). Checked through the cursor itself with a recording stand-in for iris.sql (c17-offline: none of the four statements reached it) and the upstream unit test test_transaction_statements_are_noop (c17-run-unit-ops, passed). The irispython E2E (USER_GUIDE example inside IRIS) needs the package installed in the container's embedded Python: blocked-access (installing it would modify the container).
findings.remedy: Map the statements to TSTART/TCOMMIT/TROLLBACK (or pass them through) in EmbeddedCursor, or document the limit; an irispython E2E of the USER_GUIDE example.
findings.notes: End-to-end effect inside IRIS: blocked-access (iris_vector_graph not installed in the container's irispython; installing it would change the container).

IVG works in the connection's namespace, 'AUDITC': drop namespace= or connect to 'USER'."]. Source iris_vector_graph/stores/iris_sql_store.py:830-838 (warnings.warn, no raise).

findings.title: The error root does not catch every IVG error
findings.intended: iris_vector_graph/errors.py:1-17: every engine-side error descends from IVGError, one catchable root.
findings.observed: c17-offline: the nine classes the finding names are not IVGError subclasses (MRO recorded); a mechanical scan of every exception class the package defines finds 26 outside IVGError, e.g. BatchShortfall, _NotALiteral, SnapshotReadError, AQLParseError, AQLTranslationError, _Decline, NativeMismatch, CypherParseError, EntityNotFoundError, TemporalQueryRequiresEngine, _NoFold, EmbeddedUnavailableError.
findings.remedy: Re-base the public errors on IVGError (keep current bases as mixins) or narrow the docstring; extend test_all_descend_from_single_root to every exported error.

findings.title: vector_similarity_search ranks L2 results farthest first
findings.intended: A similarity search returns the nearest rows (docstring, dbapi_utils.py:249-252); VECTOR_L2 is a distance (P-1710).
findings.observed:
Source: metric='L2' maps to VECTOR_L2 and the statement orders score DESC (dbapi_utils.py:256-272). Live (c17-live-vec, IRIS IRIS for UNIX (Ubuntu Server LTS for x86-64 Containers) 2026.1 (Build 234U) Fri Mar 27 2026 14:07:14 EDT, scratch table IVGAudit.C17V rows 1:[0,0], 2:[1,0], 3:[5,0]): vector_similarity_search(metric='L2') -> ProgrammingError: <SQL ERROR>; Details: [SQLCODE: <-359>:<SQL Function (function stored procedure) not found>]
[Location: <Prepare>]
[%msg: < User defined SQL function 'SQLUSER.VECTOR_L2' does not exist>]; raw VECTOR_L2 -> ProgrammingError: <SQL ERROR>; Details: [SQLCODE: <-359>:<SQL Function (function stored procedure) not found>]
[Location: <Prepare>]
[%msg: < User defined SQL function 'SQLUSER.VECTOR_L2' does not exist>]; the same call with COSINE -> [{'id': 2, 'score': '1'}, {'id': 3, 'score': '1'}, {'id': 1, 'score': None}].
findings.remedy: ORDER BY score ASC for L2 (or negate it); a test with three known vectors.
findings.notes: On IRIS Community 2026.1 VECTOR_L2 does not exist (SQLCODE -359 'User defined SQL function SQLUSER.VECTOR_L2 does not exist'), so P-1710 does not hold on the edition this audit runs and the descending order cannot be observed here; the call raises instead (F-C1704). The ordering defect applies wherever VECTOR_L2 exists.

findings.title: One HTTP client call can create a write twice (client resend after a late reply; server re-run after an exception)
findings.intended: decisions.md HD-1702 / HD-1603 (working): after an ambiguous outcome retry only a read, a write known not to have run, or one with a verified idempotency key; treat client and server retries as one protocol.
findings.observed: Live (c17-live-server): IVGClient(timeout=2 s, max_retries=3) through a proxy that held the first reply 4 s sent one CREATE (n:C17Dup {marker}); the proxy saw 2 requests, the client answered {'rows': [['c17dup-1794613789']]}, and AUDITC holds 2 nodes with that marker. Source: sdk.py:209-228 resends a POST after TimeoutException/ConnectError/5xx whatever the query; IVGServerError.is_retryable is any 5xx (sdk.py:41-42); cypher_api.py:250-268 re-runs execute_cypher on a fresh connection after any exception. Model: cmc-retry-as-built-once (expected-violation), cmc-retry-as-built-honest (expected-violation: a definite failure reported for an applied write), cmc-retry-reviewed (pass), controls cmc-retry-ctl-client/-server.
findings.remedy: Retry only reads or writes known not to have run (connect error before send); report an unknown outcome for an ambiguous write; or carry an end-to-end idempotency key (the ledger's retry key) through /api/cypher.
findings.notes: Intent status: HD-1702/HD-1603 are working assumptions (decisions.md), not maintainer decisions; the duplicate is observed behaviour either way. Shared with module 16 (server half).

findings.title: Two declared console scripts cannot run from an install
findings.intended: pyproject.toml:176-179 declares console scripts run-tests and networkx-loader beside ivg.
findings.observed: c17-offline: run-tests -> {'exit': 1, 'stderr_tail': ['    from scripts.test import main', "ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scripts.test'"]}; scripts/test.py tracked at the pin: False; the wheel packages only ['iris_vector_graph'] (pyproject.toml wheel config), so scripts.ingest.networkx_loader is absent from a wheel install (it resolved here only because the venv's editable install puts a source checkout on sys.path).
findings.remedy: Drop the two entries or ship the modules they name.

findings.title: `ivg server start --workers N` (N > 1) exits without serving
findings.intended: docs/ADMIN_API.md:20 documents --workers; OPS-B1.12 (uvicorn.run(cypher_api.app, host, port, workers)).
findings.observed: Live (c17-live-server-workers): `ivg server start --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18799 --workers 2` printed uvicorn's 'You must pass the application as an import string to enable reload or workers' and exited 1; cli.py:437-438 passes the app object.
findings.remedy: Pass the import string 'iris_vector_graph.cypher_api:app' to uvicorn.run, or drop the option; the product's own N-process path then exists for the 1-vs-N validation.
findings.notes: Consequence for gate 3.7 (1 vs N application processes): the documented multi-process server path does not start.
